newsitem.title: JAPAN: Strong chip data lifts Japan chip-related issues.
newsitem.headline: Strong chip data lifts Japan chip-related issues.

text.p: Strong U.S. chip data for November lifted shares of Japan's semiconductor-related issues in Tuesday morning trade, brokers said.
As of 0029 GMT, shares in Advantest Corp were 80 yen higher at 5,050 yen. Tokyo Electron Ltd was up 80 yen to 3,480 yen.
The Semiconductor Industry Association's book to bill ratio, which measures the value of orders against shipments, rose to 1.15 in November from a revised 1.11 in October.
The trade group said the November ratio is the highest since October of 1995 when it jumped to 1.16.
